Evening at the cafe? The moonvine hums about you. Keep those trays steady.
Cafe key in your pocket! The geraniums on my sill just straightened up.
Rainy cafe shift, I heard. My ferns love a damp day too. Customers still came.
Cafe apron on you? I want one in marigold yellow. The petals agree with me.
You hum while you pour? The larkspur heard it through the window. I hum back.
Cafe trays and tired arms! Nasturtiums say rest them in the shade. I will watch.
Opening shift with Mocha? The morning glories woke early just to see. So did I.
Cafe chairs got wiped twice! My tidy pansies approve of that. Every speck gone.
You mixed cocoa today? The seed packets smell it from here. Smells like spring soil.
Cafe windows all steamy! The orchids admire the fog. It is cozy weather.
You filled the sugar jars? The bees would like a word. And so would I.
Mocha's helper counting coins! My four o'clocks count too. They stop at noon.
Cafe work suited you! Alyssum whispered it in my ear. I believe every word.
You learned latte art? The camellias want a leaf drawn on top. They asked politely.
Cafe shift before sunrise! My zinnias were not awake. I faked it anyway.
You restocked the cocoa? The sweet peas started clapping. I joined right in.
Mocha's cafe raves about you! Even the wisteria leans in to listen. I lean farther.
You wore a paper hat? The daisies want one in white. They are all petals, no paper.
Cafe shift in new shoes! My cornflowers felt that too. Sore feet, happy work.
You took the late order? Night phlox stays up with you. So do I, usually.
Cafe bell kept ringing! My bluebells answered it. Wrong building, still cheerful.
You brewed the strong pot? The foxgloves like it bold. They said so at dawn.
Mocha's cafe in the rain! Petunias opened umbrellas indoors. Charming little things.
You balanced six cups? My columbines tried that once. Once was plenty.
Cafe courtyard sweepings! The dandelions puff with pride. You missed a corner.
Cafe hours after dark! Evening stock blooms for you. I keep the porch light on.
Cafe cloths folded neatly! My tidy thrift approves. She folds hers by color.
You ran the whole cafe solo? The sunflowers stood up straighter. I nearly fainted.
Cafe cocoa for the children? My violas melt at that. So does the marshmallow.
Morning shift in cold air! The heather knows that chill. Wool socks, I insist.
You stacked the saucers high! My fritillaria counts them. She stopped at twelve.
Cafe shift during market! My hyacinths sniffed the bread. Now they want shifts too.
Mocha's cafe praised by travelers! My asters tell everyone. I already told three.
You wiped the last table! The evening primrose clocked out too. Good timing, both.
Cafe shift without a break? My poppies say sit down. They mean it, truly.
You served the birthday crowd? My balloon flowers inflated with joy. Nobody popped.
Cafe cups clinked all day! My foxgloves hum along. It is almost a song.
You sorted the tea tins? My chamomile perked up at that. Sorting is soothing work.
Mocha's cafe smells of cinnamon! My spice pinks approve. The bees asked for a sip.
You worked a double today? My strawflowers understand. They also dry out slowly.
Cafe shift with muddy boots! My sedums forgive you. Boots dry, flowers wait.
You fixed the squeaky hinge? My bluebells sighed in relief. A proper quiet now.
Mocha's helper laughing loud! My coreopsis laughed too. The whole shop giggled.
You swept petals off the step? Those came from my shop. It is a trade now.
Cafe shift and a scraped thumb! My calendula sends salve. Wrap it up quick.
You counted tips at closing? My money plant did too. Vice versa, actually.
Cafe was extra crowded! My bee balm was jealous. It draws crowds with scent.
You turned the sign to open! My morning glories unfold the same way. Slow and proud.
You carried the water jug! My pitcher plants applaud. They are experts, you know.
Cafe shift before deliveries! My sweet peas waited at the door. You arrived first.
You mopped every corner! My moss approves of damp work. It is a compliment.
Cafe had a menu change! My asters read it twice. Better than gossip, almost.
You made the scarf look easy? Mine stole it earlier. She left a leaf behind.
Cafe shift on a Monday! My daisies call that brave. Braver than the irises.
You met the banker's cat! My catmint shivered at the name. Coolly, of course.
Cafe batch of scones sold out! My milkweed knew. Sticky days are good days.
You borrowed Mocha's apron! Mine has soil in the pocket. Keep that one clean.
You wrote the specials board? My penstemons spell too. They prefer dirt writing.
Cafe shift on roller skates? Brainstorm, not real. My snapdragons love the idea.
Cafe closed early today? My four o'clocks opened faster. Rumor said rain.
